title: Thousands March in Paris Against Police Self-Defense Presumption Law
detail: Thousands of demonstrators took to the streets in Paris on September 20, 2026, to protest a proposed law that would grant police a presumption of legitimate self-defense. Critics argue the measure would shield officers from accountability in cases of excessive force.

title: Debate Over Article 25 of Sexual Violence Law That Could Ban OnlyFans in France
detail: A debate has emerged in France over Article 25 of the comprehensive sexual violence law currently under discussion, which contains provisions that critics and supporters say could effectively ban platforms like OnlyFans. The article targets online spaces facilitating sexual exploitation, raising questions about the scope of the legislation and its impact on legal adult content platforms.
